title: Issue → Verified Fix
boundary: Repository-local workflow · human approval before merge

nodes.title: Issue reported
nodes.subtitle: capture observed behavior
nodes.detail: Record what happened, what was expected, and the smallest known reproduction without assuming a cause.

nodes.title: Reproduce
nodes.subtitle: make the failure deterministic
nodes.detail: Create a red-capable test or command that proves the failure before changing implementation code.

nodes.title: Inspect context
nodes.subtitle: trace the affected path
nodes.detail: Read the relevant code, tests, logs, and interfaces to identify where the observed behavior diverges from the intended contract.

nodes.title: Diagnose cause
nodes.subtitle: reconcile evidence
nodes.detail: Combine the deterministic reproduction with the code-path evidence and state one falsifiable root-cause explanation.

nodes.title: Implement fix
nodes.subtitle: change the narrowest seam
nodes.detail: Make the smallest code change that addresses the proven cause while preserving unrelated behavior and work in progress.

nodes.title: Run verification
nodes.subtitle: prove the failure is fixed
nodes.detail: Run the regression test and the relevant broader checks, recording exactly what passed and what remains unproven.

nodes.title: Review change
nodes.subtitle: check risk and clarity
nodes.detail: Review correctness, regression risk, security, readability, and whether any branching complexity was merely moved elsewhere.

nodes.title: Ready for merge
nodes.subtitle: human decision point
nodes.detail: Present the evidence, unresolved risks, and exact repository state so a human can decide whether to merge.
